editorial.meta_description: The Google Professional Cloud Developer exam validates your ability to design, build, test, and deploy scalable cloud-native applications on Google Cloud.
editorial.overview: The Google Professional Cloud Developer certification, managed by Google Cloud, evaluates your proficiency in the full development lifecycle. It covers architecting cloud-native applications, integrating machine learning capabilities, and utilizing generative AI APIs. The exam assesses your technical skills across four domains, ensuring you can build and configure secure, reliable, and highly available applications using Google-recommended tools and best practices. This certification is designed to confirm that you possess the necessary expertise to manage complex cloud environments effectively while maintaining high standards for application performance and security throughout the entire software development lifecycle process.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam is for developers with 3+ years of industry experience, including 1+ years designing and managing solutions using Google Cloud. It is suitable for professionals who build and maintain cloud-native applications and want to demonstrate their expertise in Google Cloud technologies to employers.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Start by reviewing the official exam guide to align your skills with the listed topics. Gain hands-on experience using the Google Cloud Free Tier to practice with select products. Follow the Professional Cloud Developer learning path, which includes on-demand courses, labs, and skill badges. Review sample questions to understand the format and participate in certification prep webinars to gain insights from experts. Consistent practice and review of the core domains will help you prepare for the 120 minutes of testing time.

domain_guidance.summary: This section focuses on the architecture of cloud-native applications, emphasizing scalability, security, and reliability within the Google Cloud environment. It accounts for 32.0 percent of the exam content and requires mastery of complex design patterns.

This domain covers the practical aspects of creating and validating applications, including the use of development tools and testing frameworks. It represents 23.0 percent of the exam and focuses on ensuring high-quality code and structured build processes.

This section addresses the configuration of applications for deployment, ensuring they are ready for production environments on Google Cloud. It makes up 24.0 percent of the exam, focusing on release automation and environment management for cloud-native software.

This domain focuses on connecting applications to various Google Cloud services, including AI APIs and data storage solutions. It comprises 21.0 percent of the exam, testing your ability to implement service integration and maintain data service connectivity.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: You may take the exam online from a remote location or at an onsite testing center. Ensure you have reviewed the exam terms and conditions. The exam lasts 120 minutes and consists of multiple choice and multiple select questions. Please arrive early to complete the check-in process.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consists of 50-60 multiple choice and multiple select questions. These questions cover the four domains of the certification, testing your ability to design, build, configure, and integrate applications on Google Cloud effectively.

Google Cloud does not publish the specific passing score for this certification. Candidates should focus on mastering the objectives outlined in the official exam guide to ensure they are prepared for the content covered in the exam.

The exam duration is 120 minutes. This time is provided to complete the multiple choice and multiple select questions. Ensure you manage your time effectively during the session to address all sections of the exam.

faq.question_title: What is the registration fee for the exam?
faq.answer_text: The registration fee for the Professional Cloud Developer exam is $200, plus tax where applicable. You can register for the exam through the official Google Cloud certification website and choose between remote or onsite testing options.

methodology.summary: This page was compiled by synthesizing official Google Cloud exam documentation, third-party study guides, and verified certification facts to provide a clear, accurate overview of the exam requirements, domain weights, and structure for all prospective candidates.
